cdn.description: Name or URL template of the JavaScript and/or stylesheet CDN provider

cdn_overrides.description:
CDN providers (same names as cdn) or URL templates of the packages that do not use the cdn provider above, by package name, e.g.
    jquery: unpkg
    highlight.js: https://cdn.example.com/${package}@${version}/${filename}
A URL without ${package}, ${version} or ${filename} is used as is for every file of the package, so only use it for packages that load a single file, e.g.
    clipboard: https://example.com/js/clipboard.min.js

fontcdn.description: Name or URL template of the webfont CDN provider

iconcdn.description: Name or URL of the fontawesome icon font CDN provider
